tools.name: rotate_model
tools.description: Orbit the camera around the model on screen. Positive yawDegrees moves the camera to the right around the model, negative to the left. Positive pitchDegrees moves the camera up to look down on it.

tools.name: zoom
tools.description: Move the camera closer or farther. factor 1.3 is 30 percent closer.

tools.name: zoom_to_part
tools.description: Move the camera to one labeled part.

tools.name: answer_with_screen
tools.description: Answer a question about what is on screen, with a screenshot. Use for questions, not changes.

tools.name: seek_relative
tools.description: Move the YouTube video forward (positive) or back (negative) by seconds.
